Flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Action]
    B -->|No| D[Other action]
    C --> E[End]
    D --> E
Sequence:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Alice
    participant B as Bob
    A->>B: Request
    B-->>A: Response
    Note over A,B: Optional note
State:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Active : start
    Active --> Idle : stop
    Active --> [*]
Entity Relationship:
erDiagram
    PATIENT ||--o{ VISIT : has
    VISIT ||--|{ LAB_RESULT : includes
    PATIENT {
        int id
        string name
    }
Gantt:
gantt
    title Project Timeline
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Phase 1
    Task one :a1, 2026-01-01, 14d
    Task two :after a1, 10d
    section Phase 2
    Task three :2026-02-01, 7d
Pie:
pie title Distribution
    "Category A" : 40
    "Category B" : 35
    "Category C" : 25
Mindmap:
mindmap
  root((Topic))
    Branch A
      Leaf 1
      Leaf 2
    Branch B
      Leaf 3

journey

    section Step 1

    commit

quadrantChart

    y-axis Low impact --> High impact
